totals.gross_vs_net: Decoded outflows equal the net balance drop over the whole window exactly (6,125,000 FLAPJAX), so no inflow into the treasury occurred in the window outside a same-block offset; gross outflows = net outflows = 6,125,000. A same-block inflow exactly offsetting a transfer would be invisible to the balance method (see limitations).

0x7C34E9e21eE28A49Ff0b84B61774119E663335.verified: eth_getTransactionByHash + balance 0 at block 123473816, exactly funding value at 123473817 (re-verified 2026-11-20)

grouping.note: Recipients sharing a first BNB funder are grouped above. Distinct-operator count cannot be determined from first-funder data alone: most recipients never received BNB at all, and funded recipients mostly have distinct first funders. See notable_links for harder links outside the first-funder test.

notable_links.note: The treasury itself sent 9 recipients their first (and only) BNB: 0.0005 BNB each, plain transfers (input 0x), verified by eth_getTransactionByHash. Eight of them were funded in a single 27-second burst on 2026-10-10 08:25:04-08:25:31 COT (blocks 126835347-126835408); the ninth on 2026-10-18. Eight of the nine received exactly one 15,000 FLAPJAX transfer in the window; 0xfb200657 received five transfers totalling 115,000 (25,000 on 11 Nov, 15,000 on 11 Nov, 25,000 on 16 Nov, 25,000 on 17 Nov, 25,000 on 18 Nov). All nine still hold the full 0.0005 BNB; eight have nonce 0 (never sent a tx), 0x4d2a5410 has nonce 1. This is the strongest grouping in the audit: nine recipients whose first BNB came directly from the treasury, eight of them funded within half a minute of each other.

Supplementary depth-2 check only. The three recipients' first funders were themselves first funded by 0xf70da978. That wallet has nonce 6,135,830 and holds ~189 BNB: it is a high-volume hot wallet that funds very many unrelated addresses, so this shared second-order funder does NOT by itself establish that the three recipients share an operator. Recorded for completeness; the first-order grouping above is unchanged. (The third member, 0x655681f4 via 0x56c26202, was found in the recovery pass.)

Supplementary depth-2 check only, found in the recovery pass. The three recipients' first funders were themselves first funded by 0x8894e0a0 — with 1,000, 53,846 and 1,000 BNB, in 2021. A wallet moving tens of thousands of BNB is a very high-volume funding source (exchange/hot wallet), so this shared second-order funder does NOT by itself establish that the three recipients share an operator. Recorded for completeness; the first-order grouping above is unchanged.

uncovered_tx_reason: Earliest transfer of the new days (17 Nov 13:06:01 COT, 15,000 FLAPJAX to 0x252dd866). Task awardCount is 0, so no earlier ACCEPTED claim covers any in-window transfer. Caveat: 3 earlier submissions exist on this task (filed 2026-11-20 03:13-04:41 UTC); their submission files could not be inspected — the Taskmarket CLI download endpoint returns 403 'Not authorized to preview this submission' for all three — so whether any of them named this receipt cannot be checked from here. This receipt is from 17 Nov, a day the Q101 window did not cover.

methods.amounts: integer wei throughout; no floating-point division
methods.day_boundaries: binary search on eth_getBlockByNumber timestamps + direct verification of each boundary block and predecessor (each first block's timestamp equals the day-start ts exactly; predecessor is 1 s earlier)
methods.transfer_enumeration_all_days: treasury FLAPJAX balanceOf via eth_call (archive state, bsc-mainnet.public.blastapi.io) at each day boundary: 825,016,348.1886601 at start-11 Nov; 823,471,348.1886601 at end-11 Nov; 821,926,348.1886601 at end-12 Nov; 821,911,348.1886601 at end-13 Nov; 821,161,348.1886601 at end-14 Nov; 820,966,348.1886601 at end-15 Nov; 820,041,348.1886601 at end-16 Nov; 819,896,348.1886601 at end-17 Nov; 818,891,348.1886601 at end-18 Nov (net outflows 1,545,000 / 1,545,000 / 15,000 / 750,000 / 195,000 / 925,000 / 145,000 / 1,005,000; window total 6,125,000). Binary search on balanceOf located every block where the balance drops (31 blocks 11 Nov, 103 on 12 Nov, 1 on 13 Nov, 16 on 14 Nov, 5 on 15 Nov, 59 on 16 Nov, 7 on 17 Nov, 14 on 18 Nov = 236 drop blocks); each drop block's full transactions were read and the treasury's transfer(address,uint256) call decoded (no transferFrom or other treasury-to-token calls exist in any drop block); decoded amounts match the balance drops to the wei at every block. Every transfer was then re-verified individually with eth_getTransactionReceipt (status 0x1, exactly one Transfer log from the FLAPJAX token contract, from=treasury, to and value matching).
methods.correction_vs_first_pass: The first pass of this audit (and the Q101 audit it reused) enumerated 11-16 Nov with an eth_getLogs Transfer scan and found only 3 transfers totalling 55,000 FLAPJAX. Parent verification by balance reconciliation showed the treasury actually lost 4,975,000 FLAPJAX over 11-16 Nov, so that log scan was incomplete (public BSC eth_getLogs endpoints rate-limit this VM; the scan silently missed the bulk of the window). The recovery pass re-enumerated 11-16 Nov from scratch with the balance-drop method above and found 215 transfers totalling 4,975,000, reconciling exactly. The 3 transfers the log scan did find are included in the 215 (receipt re-verified in the recovery pass). The same incompleteness very likely affects the Q101 submission, which reported the same 55,000 total for the same 11-16 Nov window.
methods.receipt_verification: eth_getTransactionReceipt per transfer (status 0x1, exactly one Transfer log from the FLAPJAX token contract, from=treasury, to and value matching the decoded call). 17-18 Nov transfers verified in the first pass; all 215 11-16 Nov transfers verified in the recovery pass (4 parallel slices, 215/215 verified).
methods.funder_lookup: eth_getBalance binary search for first nonzero block (archive state via bsc-mainnet.public.blastapi.io; free dataseeds prune history), eth_getBlockByNumber full txs for funding block, eth_getTransactionByHash for each funding tx, eth_getTransactionCount + eth_getCode per address. Second-order check (first funder of each first funder) was run for all 15 distinct first funders (4 in the first pass, 11 new in the recovery pass). Two second-order lookups are unresolved: 0x4d18632a... (a contract, nonce 281, balance 0) and 0xe9b7b519... (EOA, nonce 1, balance 0) — both may have been funded and fully drained; proving either way needs a txlist/trace API.

limitations: The funder search proves 'never received BNB' only for EOAs with nonce 0 and balance 0. For any address with nonce > 0 that had drained its balance, the first funding transaction would need a txlist/trace API (BscScan API is Cloudflare-blocked; Etherscan V2 free tier does not cover BSC). Funded recipients' funding txs were identified directly from their funding blocks.
Some funding txs carry input data (value-carrying calls, not plain transfers); the BNB value moved is verified, what the call did beyond moving value was not analysed.

Completeness rests on the balance binary search + per-block decode + exact wei reconciliation, which enumerates every balance-changing block in the window. A transfer exactly offset by an inflow in the same block would not move the balance and would be missed by that method. No independent eth_getLogs corroboration was possible: public BSC log endpoints rate-limit this VM ('limit exceeded' even for 500-block ranges) and the background log scan was stopped during the recovery pass.

Earlier Q102 submissions' coverage could not be inspected (CLI download 403 for all three). The uncovered_tx choice rests on awardCount = 0 (no accepted claim) plus the 17 Nov date; it cannot be guaranteed against pending (unaccepted) submissions.

The shared funder-of-funder (notable links 2 and 3) runs through very high-volume wallets (0xf70da978 nonce 6,135,830, ~189 BNB; 0x8894e0a0 moving 1,000-53,846 BNB) and is weak evidence; it is reported as a supplementary observation, not as proof of a shared operator.

Two second-order funder lookups are unresolved: 0x4d18632a... (contract, nonce 281, balance 0) and 0xe9b7b519... (EOA, nonce 1, balance 0). Both may have been funded and fully drained, or never funded; the sampled-block probe cannot distinguish. This affects only the depth-2 supplement — the two recipients they funded (0xc39a6255 and 0xd01f18a1) have their own first funder verified.
